title: setup hook --scope user writes the Codex, OpenCode and Pi guard files in the home folder (CODEX_HOME honored) and --remove takes them out
source: intended: setup hook for every harness (claude, codex, opencode, pi): one plan, one preview, one confirmation and one backup
intent: INTENDED behavior. At user scope the files are `$CODEX_HOME/hooks.json` (default `~/.codex/hooks.json`), `~/.config/opencode/plugins/jitso-guard.js` and `~/.pi/agent/extensions/jitso-guard.js`, printed with `~/`, with no commit note and no project trust note; nothing is written in the project. `--remove` deletes them and the folders it leaves empty.

regex: ^// generated by jitso \S+: jitso setup hook; do not edit
